name: Hiding in The Dark OG
summary:
Hiding in the Dark is a suspenseful hide-and-seek horror game where darkness is your greatest threat—and your only protection. Navigate through three eerie levels: an abandoned city, a twisted sewer system, and haunting underground caves. Use stealth, timing, and strategy to avoid being caught. Will you escape the shadows, or be consumed by them?

Perfect for fans of survival horror and immersive suspense.
